title: Cut silences

error.group: Could not read the audio of every voice in this group. Try again once the uploads have finished.
error.readClip: Could not read the audio of this clip.
error.tooBigUpload: This file is too big to analyse in the browser (over 300 MB). It can be analysed once it has finished uploading.
error.sceneUpload: Scene changes can be found once this clip has finished uploading.
error.sceneFailed: Could not look for scene changes.

atEachPause: What to do at each pause
splitHint: Splits into parts of at least {{seconds}}s and cuts the pause out at each split. Shorter pauses inside a part stay.
removeHint: Cuts out every pause; each piece of speech becomes its own part.
sceneHint: Splits where the picture changes (a new shot or angle), into parts of at least {{seconds}}s. Nothing is removed.
groupHint: A pause is only cut where everyone is quiet, and the same cut goes through every voice, so they stay in sync.
playTitle: Play the result, skipping what gets cut (Space)
sceneSummary_one: {{parts}} parts at {{count}} scene change. Nothing is removed.
sceneSummary_other: {{parts}} parts at {{count}} scene changes. Nothing is removed.
noScenes: No scene changes found with these settings.
noPauses: No pauses found with these settings.
sensitivityTitle: Higher finds softer changes too (camera moves, lighting); lower only hard cuts
autoTitle: Set just above this clip's background noise
keepStartTitle: How much of the pause stays after the words before a cut
keepEndTitle: How much of the pause stays before the words after a cut
allTitle: The same settings for every clip on the voice tracks (music stays as it is)

beat.title: Beat sync
beat.tooShort: This clip is too short to find a tempo.
beat.tooBig: This file is too big to analyse in the browser (over 300 MB).
beat.tooFast: The beat is twice too fast
beat.tooSlow: The beat is twice too slow
beat.show: Show the beats on the timeline (clips snap to them)
beat.fitTitle: Lay the clips of the video track on the beat, in order
beat.fit: Fit video clips to the beat
